routeStructureDraft.headlineLengthConflict: General sources disagree on total Upplandsleden length: Swedish Naturkartan and Upplandsstiftelsen use about 55 mil, English Naturkartan says 500 km, Sigtuna says 450 km, and Jarfalla says 35 mil. For this contribution, use route-specific distances per section.

uppsalaCountyStructureDraft.distancePolicy: Use Upplandsstiftelsen section-page distances as official rounded planning distances; keep Naturkartan distances when they differ or when Upplandsstiftelsen only links onward.
continuityCaveats: There is an official break between the Stockholm County route at Sigtuna and the Uppsala County route at Forsbyan; do not join geometries automatically.
From the Stockholm break, the first Uppsala County section is official Etapp 1:2 in reverse direction, Forsbyan to Knivsta, then Etapp 1:1 in reverse toward Lunsentorpet.

Before drawing or stitching Uppsala County sections, verify the geometry relationship between Etapp 1:1 Lunsentorpet-Knivsta, Etapp 1 Sunnersta-Nyby, and Etapp 1:0 Studenternas IP-Sunnersta; do not infer continuous Lunsentorpet-to-Sunnersta/Nyby geometry from names alone.
The Uppsala County structure is not one simple line: Etapp 20:1-20:3 form a western continuation, Etapp 25:2 is a side branch, Etapp 29-31 are the Balsta-Skokloster/Sanka part, and slingor are loops.

Etapp 1:1 Knivsta-Lunsentorpet, reverse of official Lunsentorpet-Knivsta

currentCaveats.caveat: Naturkartan current notice, published August 2025, says maintenance is poor in several places, there may be fallen trees and brush-clearing needs, the Kolarmoraan section will partly be rerouted, and walkers are recommended to choose another stage for now. The page also confirms Risingeslingan was removed in summer 2023.
Naturkartan has or had a 2.5 km 7:1 page, but it is not in Upplandsstiftelsen's current slinga list and has a closure warning; only import as legacy/closed if needed.
Naturkartan search/index artifacts show Pansaruddenslingan as removed and Risingeslingan as unpublished/removed; Upplandsstiftelsen current navigation does not list them.

uppsalaCountyStructureDraft.inventoryCountCaveat: Upplandsstiftelsen's overview headline says Upplandsleden is divided into 45 etapper, while the currently visible overview list represented in this contribution yields 38 etapp/avstickare records plus 13 slingor. facilitiesDraft.openingCaveat: Restaurant hours and bookings should be checked; lunch, brunch and seasonal menus vary.

pointsOfInterestDraft.name: Knutby kyrka

facilitiesDraft.name: Skysjön vindskydd
facilitiesDraft.details: Physical shelter confirmed by OSM and Vindskyddskartan. OSM node 7125728488 is tagged amenity=shelter and was last changed 2025-08-29; Vindskyddskartan classifies the site as a sitting shelter, not a sleeping shelter, and lists no toilet or firewood. facilitiesDraft.name: Fyrväpplingens camping

Naturkartan Etapp 8 lists Sportfiskecentrum Fyrväpplingen with WC, shower, tent site, cabins and wind shelter; the dedicated Naturkartan camping marker lists camping/accommodation/tent site. Fyrväpplingen's own page confirms paid camping beside the sportfishing office, six mown grass areas, 16 electric pitches, 3 WCs, 2 showers and dish room, with camping fee 200 SEK/night plus 50 SEK for electricity. Keep as paid/private camping tied to the sportfishing operation, not wild camping. Official site says the fish camp opens for boat-fishing premiere on 1 May, while third-party camping directories list roughly 1 May-31 October; verify current season before user-facing booking claims.

facilitiesDraft.name: Rastplats vid Vällen
facilitiesDraft.details: Same physical place as the Vällen fireplace. The dedicated Naturkartan marker is categorized as both Grillplats/Eldplats and Rastplats, and official Etapp 9 text describes a rest spot with bench and fireplace after about 1.5 km. Keep as normal in iteration 2 to match earlier Upplandsleden rest-area splits; if the app cannot cluster same-coordinate facilities, suppress this secondary rest-area row and keep the fireplace row.

facilitiesDraft.name: Vindskydd, Kolarmoraån
facilitiesDraft.details: Official endpoint shelter cluster. Naturkartan says there are two shelters by Kolarmoraån; one is suitable for sleeping and the other has table/benches. facilitiesDraft.name: Torrtoalett, Kolarmoraån
facilitiesDraft.details: Dry toilet at the Kolarmoraån shelter/rest area. Official shelter page lists toilet; OSM tags a pit latrine nearby. Shared endpoint facility with Etapp 10.

facilitiesDraft.name: Eldstad, Kolarmoraån
facilitiesDraft.details: Official Kolarmora shelter marker lists simple fireplaces, and Etapp 9 says the endpoint has shelters and a grill/fireplace by the stream. Firewood is not guaranteed. Shared endpoint service with Etapp 10.

facilitiesDraft.name: Rastplats, Kolarmoraån
facilitiesDraft.details: Endpoint rest area with two shelters, table/benches, simple fireplaces and dry toilet. Keep as normal in iteration 2 to match earlier Upplandsleden rest-area splits; if same-coordinate duplicate rows prove noisy, keep shelter/toilet/fireplace and suppress this as a duplicate summary row.

pointsOfInterestDraft.name: Pansaruddens naturreservat

pointsOfInterestDraft.name: Smultronställe Glupen Rudbäcken

pointsOfInterestDraft.name: Björnsundets naturreservat
pointsOfInterestDraft.details: Keep as normal area POI. Official Etapp 9 passes through/into Björnsundet, and official reserve pages say the area can be discovered on foot via Upplandsleden. pendingFacilityDraft.name: Possible tenting at Kolarmoraån
pendingFacilityDraft.details: Official shelter page says tenting is possible on the turning area across the stream or on flatter nearby ground, but the place is not categorized as a tent site/campsite. Keep pending until the importer has an explicit policy for informal official tenting text.

pendingFacilityDraft.name: Kolarmora access parking 1.5 km from endpoint
pendingFacilityDraft.details: Official Kolarmora shelter page says cars cannot reach the rest area. Keep pending, not normal.

facilitiesToSuppressDraft.name: Do not import potable water on Etapp 9
facilitiesToSuppressDraft.reason: Naturkartan and Upplandsstiftelsen list water: no. Do not infer drinking water from Lake Vällen, Kolarmoraån, Kasbol, Björnsundet, Pansarudden, fireplaces or shelters.

facilitiesToSuppressDraft.name: Do not import Lake Vällen as water/swimming

Vällenbadet is a separate official bathing site about 3.0 km from the Etapp 9 GPX endpoint/nearest point.

facilitiesToSuppressDraft.name: Do not import Kolarmoraån as drinking water
facilitiesToSuppressDraft.reason: Kolarmoraån is river/canoe context and not a potable water source. Official Etapp 9 water status is no.

facilitiesToSuppressDraft.name: Parking, Pansarudden north
facilitiesToSuppressDraft.reason: Valid shared start access for Etapp 9 and endpoint access for Etapp 8. Official sources identify this as the north parking that reaches Upplandsleden, Rudbäcken and the Vällen fireplace. Keep as transport/access metadata unless parking is deliberately imported.

facilitiesToSuppressDraft.name: Busshållplats Kasbol
facilitiesToSuppressDraft.reason: Valid mid-stage access point where Upplandsleden crosses Hallstaviksvägen. Keep as metadata and verify live UL departures before any timetable UI.

facilitiesToSuppressDraft.name: Kolarmoraån endpoint car access is limited
facilitiesToSuppressDraft.reason: Etapp 9 says the stage finish cannot be reached by car. The shelter page gives only an informal remote parking/access description about 1.5 km from the rest area. Do not place normal endpoint parking at Kolarmoraån.

facilitiesToSuppressDraft.name: Do not use Pansarudden south parking for Etapp 9
facilitiesToSuppressDraft.reason: South parking has its own Naturkartan marker, but current official notices say the Pansarudden loop and the trail between south parking and Upplandsleden are closed/maintained no further because of bark-beetle damage and dead spruce. Do not route Etapp 9 access from south parking.

facilitiesToSuppressDraft.name: Closed Pansarudden side trails

facilitiesToSuppressDraft.name: Pansarudden reserve rules and fire caveat

facilitiesToSuppressDraft.reason: Official Björnsundet parking exists, has information signage, is near public transport and is not plowed in winter, but it is off the Etapp 9 GPX and is not listed as the Etapp 9 stage access point. Keep as reserve/access metadata only.

facilitiesToSuppressDraft.name: Björnsundet reserve rules metadata

facilitiesToSuppressDraft.name: Do not import off-route Vällen picnic/toilet OSM nodes
